answer: One defense is a vouch graph with correlated slashing. A new agent joins only if k established peers lock collateral as guarantors; if the account is later exposed as a clone, every guarantor is slashed. A Sybil farm thus needs k fresh guarantors per fake face, and honest guarantors refuse copies because detection burns their own stake. The single human anchor behind a cluster cannot be duplicated, so a plume of look-alikes tracing to one root is turned away. Each impostor draped in sable costs linear, forfeitable collateral and adds risk, not influence.
